header: The trains of Asansol Junction (ASN) that a person at Durgapur can only have from Asansol: the trains that stop at Asansol and do NOT stop at Durgapur (DGR). I split them into two kinds, and the card says which:
* "pass" - the train runs over Durgapur WITHOUT stopping (Durgapur is on its line, RailRadar lists it there as a pass-through), and stops at Asansol: to take it, go to Asansol;

* "away" - the train does not go over Durgapur at all (it is not in Durgapur's timetable, neither as a stop nor as a pass-through) and stops at Asansol: its way is elsewhere (Gomoh, Adra, Tatanagar, Andal, Sainthia...).

I leave out a train that stops at BOTH, because it can be had at Durgapur. Nothing is guessed: the two lists come from two timetables of RailRadar's station board (GET /v1/stations/{code}/trains; with includeIntermediate=true the board also lists the trains that pass a station without stopping, stopType "pass-through"): Asansol's board (the trains that stop: stopType halt, origin or destination), and Durgapur's board with the pass-throughs included. My rule: a train of Asansol's board whose number is among Durgapur's stops is dropped; one among Durgapur's pass-throughs is "pass"; any other is "away". Each train goes through the same reader as the Durgapur card (readRow in railway.ts): its time AT ASANSOL (the departure, or the arrival for a train that ends there) and the days it is AT ASANSOL (moved on from the starting station's days by the arrival day). I keep the local (MEMU) trains apart, as at Durgapur. An answer that is not the expected one, or that lacks the pass-through rows (so that "pass" and "away" could not be told apart), is an error, never a guess.

behaviours: 17 rows of Asansol's board give 11 trains: 4 that stop at Durgapur too are left out, and 2 that only pass Asansol are not trains to take there
a train that stops at BOTH stations is not listed (15048, 15050, 15052, 13051), nor one that only passes Asansol (00441, 00442)
a train that passes Durgapur without stopping and stops at Asansol is 'pass': the Rajdhanis 12301 and 12302, the Duronto 22213, Garba 12937 and Himgiri 13042 (5)
a train that is not in Durgapur's timetable at all is 'away': South Bihar 13287, Asansol-Hatia 13513, Tatanagar-Buxar 18183, the special 03512, Parasnath 12941, the MEMU 63541 (6)
the local (MEMU) train is kept apart from the express and mail trains, and the special stays among the express ones
the time is the time AT ASANSOL: a train that starts there has only a departure (13513 at 04:10), one that ends there only an arrival (12941 at 10:10)
the days are the days AT ASANSOL, moved on from the starting station: 22213 leaves Shalimar on Mon, Wed, Fri and is at Asansol after midnight on Tue, Thu, Sat; 13287 is daily
the lists are in the order of the clock at Asansol (00:15 first, 18:49 last)
the filters: only the trains that run today, without the specials, and one of the two kinds
an answer that is not a success, is for another station, or has no list of trains is refused (either board)
a Durgapur board WITHOUT the pass-through rows is refused (every train would otherwise look as if it did not go over Durgapur), and so is one with too few trains
an Asansol board with too few trains is refused; more than a tenth unreadable is refused; one bad train among many is skipped
a stop of a kind that is not known (not halt, origin, destination or pass-through) is counted as unreadable, never taken for a stop
